question: What parts and pillars are specified for the Dharma–Nanda set beginning from the eastern portion?
premises: A named set is given as Dharma–Nanda.
Pillars are listed beginning from the eastern part and so on.
inference: For Dharma–Nanda there are eight dhātu-parts; from the eastern part onward the pillars are specified.
uncertainties: Precise technical sense of 'dhātu aṃśāḥ' in this architectural context.
plain_english: Dharma–Nanda: eight dhātu parts; from the eastern part etc., the pillars are (set).
